summary: Build a professional, clean, mobile-friendly Payment Entry and Collection Tracking System web app for ADPL (distribution company), including role-based login, admin dashboard, Excel raw data upload, payment entry with split modes, excess handling, reports/exports, and audit/validation features; layout ready for backend integration.
architectural_notes: Build as a simple web-based application layout ready for further backend integration.
Support Excel (.xlsx) import/export for raw data and reports.
Implement role-based access control (Admin/Salesman/Supplier), including admin-only edit permissions.
Maintain audit metadata on payment entries (timestamp and user who entered/edited).
known_issues: Previous build attempt failed (AI unable to implement request); user requested retry.

User reports role mismatch: after selecting/saving Admin in UI, app still shows role as User and Upload Excel option remains hidden (possible role assignment/UX issue with Internet Identity-based roles).

existing_features.title: Implement authentication using Internet Identity and role-based access control with roles: Admin, Salesman, Supplier. Provide a secure login screen that signs in with Internet Identity and then redirects to the correct dashboard/landing page based on the user’s assigned role.

Create an Admin Dashboard UI that shows summary cards for: Total Outstanding, Total Collection, Excess Collection, and Pending Balance. Display the company name “ADPL” prominently in the header and include the footer text “© 2026 ADPL Distribution Management System”.

Build a Raw Data Upload module for Admin to upload Excel (.xlsx) containing columns: Retailer Code, Retailer Name, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Salesman Name, Balance Amount. Parse the file client-side, validate required columns, and send the parsed rows to the backend to be stored. After upload, auto-display the dataset in a paginated table.
Add table tools on the Raw Data list: search by retailer name, search by retailer code, search by invoice number, and filter by salesman name.

Implement the Payment Entry workflow: clicking a retailer/invoice row opens a Payment Entry Form showing read-only invoice fields (Retailer Code/Name, Invoice Number/Date, Salesman Name, Balance Amount) and an editable Payment Entry section with required Type (SRR1 Supplier / SRR2 Salesman / TFC) and multi-mode payments.

Support split/part payments via an “Add Another Payment Mode” action that allows entering multiple payment lines (e.g., part cash, part cheque, part UPI). Auto-calculate the total entered amount and compare it to the invoice Balance Amount in real time.

Implement validation rules on the Payment Entry Form: amounts cannot be negative; cheque number is mandatory when Cheque is selected; transaction ID is mandatory when NEFT/RTGS/UPI is selected; cannot submit an empty payment form; require at least one payment line with a positive amount.

Implement excess payment handling: determine status based on total entered vs Balance Amount (Fully Paid, Partially Paid, Excess Payment). If excess occurs, show the warning text exactly: “Entered amount exceeds balance. Excess will be recorded.” Store the excess amount separately from normal collection in backend records.
On submit of a payment entry, save the entry, update remaining balance automatically, and display the confirmation message exactly: “Payment successfully recorded for ADPL”.

Add Payment History per retailer/invoice: provide a view that lists all recorded payments with timestamp, entered-by, type, mode line items, totals, and status. Expose this from the backend and render it in the frontend.

Implement Admin-only edit of an existing payment entry: Admin can open a recorded payment entry, modify it (including split lines), and save changes; the system must recompute related totals (remaining balance, total collected, excess) consistently.

Create a Reports section with filters (date range, salesman, type, mode of payment) and outputs: Total Collected, Total Excess, Pending Balance, and a Retailer-wise Ledger. Provide an Excel export download of report results.
Apply a corporate, clean, professional Blue & White visual design system across the app with mobile-responsive layouts and consistent UI for forms, tables, and dashboard cards.
Promote the current draft build of the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System to the Live (public) version now, without making additional functional changes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Role-based login system (Admin, Salesman, Supplier) with secure login page and post-login dashboard redirect
Admin dashboard with summary cards (Total Outstanding, Total Collection, Excess Collection, Pending Balance) and Excel report download
Raw data upload module for .xlsx with required columns, auto-display table, search (retailer name/code), and filter by salesman
Payment entry form opened from retailer/invoice row with read-only invoice fields and payment type + multi-mode payment inputs (Cash/Cheque/NEFT-RTGS-UPI)
Part/split payment support with 'Add Another Payment Mode', auto-total calculation, and comparison to balance amount
Excess payment handling with status (Fully Paid/Partially Paid/Excess Payment), warning message, and separate excess storage
Submission workflow to save payment entry, auto-update remaining balance, and show confirmation message
Reports section with filters (date range, salesman, type, mode), retailer-wise ledger, totals (collected/excess/pending), and Excel export
UI/UX design requirements: corporate blue/white theme, ADPL header, clean dashboard cards, mobile responsive, paginated tables, professional layout
Extra features: search by invoice number, payment history per retailer, admin-only edit entry, auto timestamp, and user tracking (who entered data)
Validation rules: no negative amounts; cheque number required if cheque; transaction ID required if online; cannot submit empty form
Footer text: © 2026 ADPL Distribution Management System

Implement backend data models and storage for raw uploaded invoices, payment entries, users/roles, and computed balances, including audit fields (created timestamp and entered-by principal) on every payment entry.
